description: The payload is written into the initial 1,024 bytes at the start of the Ext4 image. This region is reserved for a bootloader and precedes the superblock at offset 1,024, so regular filesystem data structures remain unchanged.
plaintext_preview: HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA HIDDEN DATA ...
notes: The boot sector region spans bytes 0–1023 from the image start.
Primary superblock begins at offset 1,024 in Ext4, outside this region.
